The frozen LintEngine verdict (crate::cpp::legacy_lint_verdict) is recomputed over the syntax and tooling targets once the tooling ran: '0 Violations Found', the first two tool warnings, '<F> Errors, <W> Warnings Found', or the joined tool errors.
